about: B107 (QA-296, QA-299, QA-300; C6.11, C7.7; P-319: data, never code): which box of a form takes an answer, and which part of a form a person writes by hand, each from the form's own printed words and scripts, cited (P-170). The configured checkpoint proposes each one as the author and a second person approves it (api/src/features/checkpoint/045-form-field-gates.ts, api/src/form-field-gates.ts); a release then carries it. A gate is a condition in the rules' own language on facts the shared library holds: the form field is written only while it holds, so a question whose every form field on a form is gated off is not asked for that form. The official files are the local copies under official-sources/ircc/ (manifest.json). Every entry is Sample, Unconfirmed: expert (AGENTS rule 4). Legal points: Unconfirmed: no counsel.

gates.words: the representative is, or will be, compensated and is a member in good standing of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC)
gates.cite: IMM 5476 (11-2021) p. 1, question 6 (ii): "(ii) is, or will be, COMPENSATED and is a member in good standing of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC)" then "Membership ID number"; the form's own script on that tick: "ICCRCMember.access = 'open'; province.rawValue = null; … membership.rawValue = null; … quebecLaw.rawValue = null". Read 7 Nov 2026.

gates.words: the representative is, or will be, compensated and is a member in good standing of a Canadian provincial or territorial law society
gates.cite: IMM 5476 (11-2021) p. 1, question 6 (ii): "a Canadian provincial or territorial law society" then "Which province or territory?" and "Membership ID number"; the form's own script on that tick: "ICCRCMember.rawValue = null; … province.access = 'open'; membership.access = 'open'; quebecLaw.rawValue = null". byHand.words: the designated individual is someone who will not act as your representative, so the case holds no such person: the applicant writes their name and contact details in parts 5 and 6 by hand
byHand.cite: canada.ca "Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual (IMM 5475)" (page-imm5475.html, downloaded 2026-10-19): "Use this form if you want to allow us to give your personal information, such as the status of your application, to someone who will not act as your representative." The form itself, p. 1: "However, they will not be a representative who can conduct business with CIC and CBSA on your behalf. If you wish to be represented, you must complete and submit form Use of a Representative (IMM 5476)." Read 7 Nov 2026.
